comments.P: Thesis/hierarchy/signature still speak make-slot desk, plate recognition, grade/size, secondary SKUs — leather ecommerce language on a harbour log console. Imageless + near-black/amber scraps are right; the direction is domain-contaminated.
comments.Q: Commit desk done right: full-width form strip + append-only mono passage tape, Inbound|Outbound two-state lock as signature, six tokens, amber fault-only, Ctrl+Enter, all four states, density-8/motion-1. Strongest complete ops build package.
comments.R: Two-column compose-left / log-right cockpit with always-on status strip is equally operational and pack-true; amber rationing and imageless discipline are excellent. Signature is slightly more standard than Q’s direction lock or T’s chalk board.
comments.S: Product Demo + Features and Swiss/Minimalism with Rubik/Nunito and blue/orange system palette is marketing chrome on a density-8 work app; motion cues fight motion-1. Signature is a mark name, not a control.
comments.T: Movements Board / chalk-entry head strip is the most harbour-specific signature while staying imageless and density-8; Ctrl+Enter stamp and amber-only faults hold. Type roles are a bit less pinned than Q’s Plex Sans+Mono lock.
